product.name: Super Payments Platform
product.description: A payment processing platform that enables businesses to accept payments with 0% transaction fees across multiple payment methods.

product.name: Cash Rewards
product.description: A rewards system that gives customers cash back on purchases made through Super Payments to encourage repeat business.

product.name: Super Offers (Advertising Platform)
product.description: A pay-per-click advertising platform that helps businesses acquire new customers by displaying targeted offers to shoppers.

product.name: Payment Add-ons
product.description: Optional paid features that provide additional payment functionalities and services to merchants.

product.name: Business Funding Cash Advance
product.description: A financing service offering flexible cash advances up to 25% of a business's turnover.
